paragraphs: Autoagent sells payment software to local government offices, built around the work of collecting public revenue. The company says its payment products work together or independently, to fit how a government office operates.

EscrowCloud handles bulk property tax payments by holding current tax data that mass payers must pay against, so they cannot submit a different amount or pay on an invalid property ID. A tax office adds its start and due dates to the system, and payers are notified of the collection cycle in real time. On the payer side, each parcel is validated and the amounts and exceptions are displayed before payment. The company states that it works with data files from all major tax administration systems. A second product, MuniciPay, brings online, in-person, IVR, eCheck, bankcard and mobile wallet payments into one platform. A third lets residents split an annual property tax bill into monthly payments.

The company describes county and municipal tax offices across 48 states as its users. It states that the platform integrates directly with more than 900 tax offices nationwide. EscrowCloud is free for property tax offices, with mortgage lenders, tax servicers and property managers paying a per-property fee. The company says the product is PCI DSS Level 1 certified and SOC 2 Type 2 compliant.

quote.text: EscrowCloud is always free for property tax offices.
